chapter: Brawls, the Ink Spots and boyhood recollections
title: Nazarro pays the fine and the case ends
summary: Nazarro peels off a $50 bill, the case is beaten, and Bubbles contacts his wife next day.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Now, I done hit the cop -- understand -- I did all this mess. Now what's left is to get out of this. How am I going to

get out of it. Not Nazarro got me out of it. He came up to see what was the matter and he took out his money, a wad of bills and started pressing down, "Did they hurt you that much? Did they hurt you that much?" I said, "No, it's all right." He gave them a $50 bill and went to court, beat the case. That ended that.
What happened to Buck and your wife and his wife?

Look, Buck has gone home, his wife has gone home. They don't go with me. They go on home. 'Cause they don't know where I went. I was running, you know. I get the cab that goes straight ahead. They don't know where I'm going. So they go home.
I contacted them the next day.
Yeh, I contacted her the next day, 'cause I was where, 'cause I know they're going to look for me home, 'cause I don't go there, you know. But I got out of

that, Thank God. But I scaled some close quarters in life. But I made it. But I got out of that and everything, because I wasn't the kind of guy to get in anything. That's how I got out. I had a good reputation on everything I went in. A good reputation when I got in there -- before I got in, you know. So that's what helped me to get out.
